name: Securities Option SD 9
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action option securities movement details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

PayoutType.name: Payout Type
PayoutType.definition: Specifies the type of payout associated with the event (for example: principal, long term capital gain).

DTCPayMethod.name: DTC Pay Method
DTCPayMethod.definition: Indicates the type of payment. Used in stock dividends processing at DTC(The Depository Trust Corporation). Valid values list will be maintained separately from the schema.

DTCPayOrder.name: DTC Pay Order
DTCPayOrder.definition: Indicates the payment order. Used in stock dividends processing at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation). Valid values list will be maintained separately from the schema.

ReinvestmentIncomeClassification.name: Reinvestment Income Classification
ReinvestmentIncomeClassification.definition: Income classification of the cash proceeds for dividend reinvestment.

EntitlementCalculationMethod.name: Entitlement Calculation Method
EntitlementCalculationMethod.definition: Indicates how the entitlements were calculated optional dividends.

PriceBasis.name: Price Basis
PriceBasis.definition: Price is based on either base or disbursed security.

DTCExitExplanationIndicator.name: DTC Exit Explanation Indicator
DTCExitExplanationIndicator.definition: Specifies the reason for DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation) to exit the shares.

ChargeFlag.name: Charge Flag
ChargeFlag.definition: Indicates whether a DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation) participant, using one or more payment bonds in connection with a warrant exercise, will be charged (through settlement on exercise date) the value of the upcoming interest payment on the bond(s).

ProtectChargeFlag.name: Protect Charge Flag
ProtectChargeFlag.definition: Indicates whether a charge is levied on the protect instructions at the time when the protect is submitted or at the time of the cover. Applies to warrants or rights exercise scenario where the holder must put up money with rights or warrants execution. When this flag is set to yes - charges are due at the time of the protect, when it is set to "no" changes are due when protect is covered.

EstimatedPriceFlag.name: Estimated Price Flag
EstimatedPriceFlag.definition: Indicates whether the price from the offeror is estimated or final.

DTCFractionalShareInstructionPeriod.name: DTC Fractional Share Instruction Period
DTCFractionalShareInstructionPeriod.definition: Time period during which instructions regarding the disposition of fractional entitlements will be accepted at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

DTCUSTaxInstructionPeriod.name: DTCUS Tax Instruction Period
DTCUSTaxInstructionPeriod.definition: Indicates the period during which the instructions for US Tax service will be accepted at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

RDPReferenceNumber.name: RDP Reference Number
RDPReferenceNumber.definition: Unique DTCC legacy reference used for matching and reconciling legacy CCF records. The element will be populated to all levels of the message (event details, options, movements) where applicable to indicate how values are sourced from CCF legacy files. For example: event has 2 related activity types 74, and 54. If event details and cash option are sourced from the activity type 74, then activity type 74 will be in RDP reference number in event details, and also on the cash option. The activity type 54 will be "on" the security option. Also, usage rules will specify the different layouts of the RDP reference number based on DTCC event group (reorganization, distribution, or redemption).
